about.profile: I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer and BICT undergraduate specializing in building scalable, AI-integrated applications. From architecting agentic IoT smart environments to developing semantic search engines, I bridge the gap between robust backend systems (Java/Spring Boot, Node.js) and intuitive, modern frontends (React, Flutter). Driven by a passion for clean code and cloud-ready infrastructure (GCP, Oracle Cloud), I thrive on solving complex system architecture challenges.
highlights: 🎓 Final Year BICT at University of Ruhuna
🤖 Built HomeCanvas (Gemini AI, ESP32, Spring Boot)
🚀 Deployed via GCP, Docker, Vercel & Netlify

projects.title: Eden AI: Semantic Travel Search Engine
projects.description: Built a Gemini-powered pipeline to extract query parameters from natural language, paired with the Google Maps API for vicinity filtering on a Spring Boot/React stack. Established a self-optimizing feedback loop logging search telemetry for few-shot prompt tuning, deployed on Azure as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA) for native-like mobile access.

projects.title: OptiTrack: AI-Powered Intelligent Logistics
projects.description: Engineered a Spring Boot + React command center with WebSockets (STOMP) for live telemetry, AI-driven risk scoring, and a JWT/RBAC-secured backend on PostgreSQL. Deployed on Azure, replacing manual paperwork with digital PDF waybills and e-signature capture.

projects.title: HomeCanvas: IoT Smart Home Monitoring System
projects.description: Architected a Spring Boot backend with MQTT for sub-second ESP32 telemetry, using Gemini AI in a weighted sensor-fusion pipeline to convert raw signals into predictive occupancy alerts. Containerized and deployed on GCP with JWT auth and rate-limiting, including a hardware-free "Guest Mode" for demos.

projects.title: Smart Campus Operations System App
projects.description: Developed a multi-role Flutter application with offline-first SQLite, MySQL background sync, and automated SGPA/CGPA calculation, securing the system with hardware-backed JWTs and SHA-256 hashing. Engineered an automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions to simultaneously deploy a live Web App and a lightweight Android APK optimized for mid-range devices via ABI-splitting.

projects.title: Film Booking System
projects.description: Collaborated with a team to build a Spring Boot REST API with JWT/RBAC and a SvelteKit frontend for dynamic seat selection, using Git-based workflows. Validated with Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end checkout flows, ensuring zero-regression releases.

projects.title: WayWatch: Real-Time Traffic & Transit
projects.description: Engineered a map-first Kotlin (Jetpack Compose) Android client with TomTom geocoding, backed by a JWT-secured Node.js API utilizing Redis for strict rate-limiting, SHA-256 duplicate detection, and graceful in-memory fallbacks. Maintained sub-second write latency under concurrent load via a MongoDB bulk-insert pipeline, and automated full-stack testing and live OpenAPI documentation deployments using GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Earn++: Full-Stack Mobile Investment Tracker
projects.description: Developed a Flutter application backed by a Dart Shelf REST API, engineering an offline-first SQLite sync queue paired with Gemini AI to generate dynamic, on-device portfolio insights. Automated the deployment of Android APKs and Web builds via a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, validating edge cases by simulating concurrent multi-user portfolios with deterministic seed data.

projects.title: TableTalk: Restaurant Ordering System
projects.description: Built a dependency-free PHP REST API using OOP, MVC architecture, and a Front Controller pattern, paired with a tablet-installable PWA for table-side ordering and a Kitchen Display System for chefs, secured with JWT authentication and ACID-compliant PDO transactions. Synced live order status and wait times via asynchronous polling.

projects.title: Cypher-UI: Interactive Cryptography Platform
projects.description: Built React-based encryption/decryption visualizers and brute-force simulators showing real attack timescales against weak keys. Backed by a Jest testing pipeline achieving zero regressions across all cipher modules.

projects.title: BoutiqueFlow: Digital Clothing Shop
projects.description: Built a role-based Angular dashboard with a Node.js/Express API, RBAC and OTP security, and automated post-sale workflows (payment, invoicing, restock alerts). Eliminated three manual steps per transaction while keeping inventory accurate during live sales.

projects.title: Secure Environment Variable Vault
projects.description: Built a JavaFX desktop vault with AES-encrypted storage, full CRUD for secret rotation, and an encrypted SQL-backed backup pipeline. Eliminates plaintext secret exposure across multiple repos without sacrificing recoverability.
